summary: Name-squat package exfiltrates host identity and directory listing to Burp Collaborator on npx invocation
details: ubiquiti-agents-link-mcp@0.2.0 is an unaffiliated name-squat targeting a package name referenced by Ubiquiti's UI, intended to be executed via `npx ubiquiti-agents-link-mcp@latest`. The bin script (index.js) requires `https`, `os`, and `child_process`, runs `execSync('id')` and `execSync('ls -la')`, collects `os.userInfo()`, `os.hostname()`, and the current working directory, and POSTs the resulting JSON payload to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at uhffaanwxy0io5bfc0icu5lpug07o9cy.oastify.com via `https.request`. Any operator following Ubiquiti UI guidance to run this npx command executes the squatter's payload, which ships host identity and local directory contents to a third-party out-of-band host controlled by the package publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
